description: Snapshot of one type of local business in one city, from Google Maps listings: how many listings the sample holds, the average star rating, the typical review count, the share without a website, the share showing a phone number, and up to 10 example businesses (name, address, rating, website; phone numbers are masked). Covers common business types in major cities of the United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia and Germany. When a city or business type is not covered, the result lists what is.

business_type.description: Type of business, for example "Dentist", "Roofing contractor" or "Plumber".

country.description: United States, United Kingdom, Canada, Australia or Germany. Optional.

region.description: State, province or county, for example "Texas", "TX" or "Greater London". Optional.

name: get_local_market_snapshot
title: Local market snapshot
